_comment: OpenCode Zen config. Copy this file to llm_config.json to enable AI chat answers.
_security: NEVER put a real key in this file. Put the key in the environment variable named by api_key_env.
_warning: OpenCode's free-tier models (e.g. deepseek-v4.1-flash-free) require OpenCode itself. From a normal server they may return 401. If that happens, use a paid model such as deepseek-v4.1-flash (very cheap) or another provider.
